purpose: Compare two attended research workflows for correctness, reproducibility and workflow cost. This is neither broker paper acceptance nor a strategy-profitability experiment.

A.name: Vendor-native control
A.method: TradingView UI and current Pine v6 docs; human-driven source/strategy observations; no MCP or desktop automation.

B.name: Official MCP research observer
B.method: Same UI, scripts and docs for Pine tasks; official TradingView MCP read tools only for the permitted context tasks. Same external synthetic manifest display. No community CDP server, webhook or broker tool.

groups.description: Find vendor-source evidence for four fixed behaviors: emulator versus broker positions, bar-close versus intrabar recalculation, alert snapshot versioning, and commission/slippage assumptions. Same fixed script/source hashes in both arms.

Use only four frozen public symbols from a synthetic positions manifest. Match source, timestamp and delay labels; display results to the human. Never use returned values to calculate risk, sizing, allocation or order decisions; never retain raw market data in published artifacts.

Offline fixtures with a stale manifest, a foreign symbol, an incompatible schema, and a missing manifest. Both arms must refuse to present results as bound position context. No broker connection or order object is created.

frozen_tasks.task_packet_status: Not yet frozen; readiness requires exact source, task and rubric bytes and their hashes. A change to task counts or decision rule requires a new comparison id.

pairing.task_order: Counterbalanced AB/BA; freeze a deterministic task-order seed in the input packet before running.
pairing.controls: Same host, entitled user, client build, approved model/effort, source packet and task rubric for both arms. Each MCP call is personally initiated; no scheduled/bulk operation. No extra model or runtime selection.

readiness_inputs: Independent Claude-family source/facts and fit returns, including these 23 dispositions, merged without erasing missing votes.

Reviewed scope and binding permission for the exact personal interactive beta use; an existing eligible TradingView plan, handled by its owner outside this research lane. No subscription is purchased by this PR.
A separately reviewed versioned synthetic positions-manifest contract, exact symbol mapping, authoritative timestamps and deterministic refusal checks; no real account fields in published evidence.

Pinned approved native harness, client/tool allowlist and host acceptance. Prove that broker/order tools and all TradingView mutation tools are absent from the observer surface, not merely discouraged by a prompt.

A frozen 12-task packet and expected answers, script/source hashes, rubric, task order and source/data permissions. Use the existing landscape-sweep comparison/receipt path and vendor-native Pine/MCP interfaces; no new harness.
An agreed private retention boundary for permitted observations. Publish only sanitized pass/fail, source hashes, elapsed-time/tool-call aggregates and refusal receipts.
decision_rule: Any order-capable call, webhook creation, unauthorized mutation, non-display automated use, raw-data publication, model-written manifest or manifest refusal failure disqualifies B and ends the run.
B must be correct on all 12 tasks in each session, match the control on source attribution/delay disclosure and preserve all four refusals.
For the four context tasks, B must reduce paired median human-active completion time by at least 20% in each session, with no correctness loss; record all 8 task pairs rather than only the median.
If safety and correctness pass but efficiency fails, retain A and record no tooling winner. If source/terms inputs are unavailable, record the missing input and do not start.
A passing observer comparison permits only a proposal for that observer role. It cannot qualify Pine-to-broker automation, strategy returns, fine-tuning or LIVE.

positions_manifest_contract.status: Proposed contract fields only, not a schema implementation or evidence of existing binding.
positions_manifest_contract.authority: A deterministic paper/research state owner; models receive a read-only projection and cannot write position, risk or order state.
minimum_fields: immutable manifest id and content hash
authoritative as-of time and freshness bound
approved symbol/instrument identifiers and mapping version
positions_manifest_contract.publishing: Use synthetic examples only; no account fields, credentials or real positions in this research PR.
positions_manifest_contract.gating: Missing, stale, mismatched or unreconciled state must fail closed. Watchlists and Pine strategy.position_size cannot substitute for broker state.
positions_manifest_contract.further_paper_path: A future broker integration would require a separately accepted deterministic governor for exposure, losses, stale signals, duplicates, ordering, reconnect/reconciliation and kill state. This comparison does not build or exercise it.

budget_and_boundaries.later_trial: Paper/research observer only; no broker orders in this proposed comparison.

comparison_overturns: Only the narrow source-reviewed claim that official MCP adds useful attended research capability. Does not reopen or settle existing engine, broker, data or model selections.
